rows.abstract: States that the retirement pay of all RETIRED GSIS and SSS members shall be adjusted EVERY YEAR in proportion to the buying power of the Philippine peso, but not lower than ten percent (10%) of the rate of pay during the preceding year.

rows.abstract: "Farm Machineries Manufacturing Program (EMMP) Act of 1995"; states the following objectives of the EMMP: (1) development of a viable farm machineries manufacturing industry; (2) technology transfer and development; (3) employment generation; (4) toprovide a reasonable consumer price of farm machineries; and (5) foreign exchange savings and earnings.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRADE AND INDUSTRY since 1995-02-02

rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING MANGO PRODUCERS AND EXPORTERS CERTAIN INCENTIVES TO ENCOURAGE THEM TO FORM INTO COOPERATIVES
rows.abstract: Seeks to provide the following incentives to all mango producers and exporters who shall form into cooperatives: (1) assurance of a return of their investments; (2) exemption from any and all taxes, fees and charges of whatever kind.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on ECONOMIC AFFAIRS since 1995-02-02

rows.title_full: AN ACT EXEMPTING THE RECEIPTS AND INCOME OF LOANS USED TO FINANCE AGRICULTURALLY BASED, RELATED AND/OR LOCATED ACTIVITIES AND BUSINESSES FROM TAXES
rows.abstract: States that all receipts and income of loans used to finance agriculturally --- based, -related and/or located activities and business shall be exempted from all taxes, including gross receipts tax and income tax.

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A NEW QUEDAN SYSTEM IN THE MARKETING OF PALAY, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Proposes a NEW system for marketing farmer's produce --- (1) The NFA shall determine the flow price for the palay; (2) NFA shall buy from the farmers their palay crops, and (3) a QUEDAN shall be issued for the REMAINING BALANCE, payable within 60 days for the time the palay is delivered to the warehouses.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AGRICULTURE AND FOOD since 1995-02-02

rows.title_full: AN ACT REGULATING THE CUTTING OF COCONUT TREES
rows.abstract: Specifies the EXEMPTIONS to the regulation on the cutting of coconut trees; requires a permit from the Philippine Coconut Authority prior to the cutting of trees.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AGRICULTURE AND FOOD since 1995-02-02

rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING AN ECOLOGY TRUST FUND FOR THE REHABILITATION OF OUR ENVIRONMENT AND HAZARDOUS WASTE SITES AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Mandates all corporations, partnerships and individuals engaged in mine exploration and/or logging activities to contribute to the proposed Fund; sets the amount of contribution to an amount not exceeding ten percent of the annual gross income of said corporation, partnership and individual; places the Fund under the control of the Pollution and Adjudication Board.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on ECOLOGY since 1995-02-02

rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE SOLAR ENERGY DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Creates the SOLAR ENERGY DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY which shall undertake researchers and promote the development and utilization of solar energy; prescribes the officers of the Authority, as well as the powers and functions of the Board of Directors.
